title: Linx Eden Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
THE LINX EDEN

SOLD OUT, LINX EDEN SWITCH AVAILABLE

Sleek and simple, the Linx Eden is a powerful and true convection vaporizer for the health conscious. Features quartz chamber and air insulation. Experience the clean tasty vapor at a truly affordable price.

Click here for our review

TRUE CONVECTION HEATING
Our unique convection heating design creates a prime environment for the chamber’s content to circulate evenly, delivering smooth clouds.

UPGRADED AIRFLOW DESIGN
A large quartz atomizer boasts a vapor path free from harmful toxins or plastics providing exceptional flavor and only the highest quality vapor.

FOUR TEMPS
We’ve taken the guess work out for you. The Eden is programmed with four variable temperature settings. Reach your ideal temperature in about 30 seconds.

LAVA PLATES
Now you can enjoy the best of both worlds at the same time. Vaporize your extract and dry flower together with the included stainless steel concentrate pads.

HEAT SHIELD
No synthetic insulation means the Eden may get a little warm, a small trade off for pure, untouched vapor. We’ve even provided a stylish swappable Heat Shield.

INCLUDED IN THE KIT:
1 Linx Eden, with all quartz heating chamber
1 Linx Eden magnetic mouthpiece cap
3 Linx Eden silicone mouthpiece cap
1 cleaning brush
3 glass mouthpiece tubes
1 USB-C charger
4 filter screens
3 Linx Eden lava plates
1 silicone sleeve

SPECIFICATIONS:
ATOMIZER: All quartz heating chamber. (diameter) 13mm x 11mm (depth)
BATTERY: Lithium-ion battery recharges in 3 – 4 hours via USB. 2500 mAH.
HEATING ELEMENT: Quartz chamber heats instantly and evenly.
AIR INSULATION: 100% air insulation with no synthetic materials in the vapor path.
MATERIAL: Quartz heating chamber, glass mouthpiece, metal casing.
DIMENSIONS: 24×110 mm/ 0.94×4.3inch without mouthpiece, or 24x 130mm / 0.94x 5.1inch with mouthpiece.
WEIGHT: 116g
VOLTAGE: Input: 5v, 520 mA
